titles.en: Mortis Trials Buff Manager - Local and Realms
titles.zh-CN: 死灵试炼 Buff 管理器
titles.zh-TW: 死靈試煉 Buff 管理器

image_type: UI layout renders with sample configurations; not gameplay screenshots

summaries.en: Requires SoloPlay; supports Realms. Select native Mortis Trials Buffs from the talent tree, filtered by class and skills. Fixes the unclosable picker and lingering button when disabled in DMF, with clean disable/re-enable behavior and saved selections preserved.
summaries.zh-CN: 以 SoloPlay 为前提，支持 Realms。在天赋树选择原版死灵试炼 Buff，按职业与技能筛选。本版修复 DMF 禁用后的空弹窗和残留按钮，支持随时关闭及重新启用，保留已保存选择。
summaries.zh-TW: 以 SoloPlay 為前提，支援 Realms。在天賦樹選擇原版死靈試煉 Buff，按職業與技能篩選。本版修復 DMF 禁用後的空彈窗和殘留按鈕，支援隨時關閉及重新啟用，保留已儲存選擇。

main_file_description: Requires SoloPlay; supports Realms. Select native Mortis Trials Buffs from the talent tree, filtered by class and skills. Fixes the unclosable picker and lingering button when disabled in DMF, with clean disable/re-enable behavior and saved selections preserved.
